fields.description: When on, new uploads are stored in S3. When off (or before a bucket is configured), files fall back to Frappe's local storage. Existing S3 files keep working either way.
fields.label: Enable S3 Storage

fields.description: Leave blank to use the server's EC2 IAM role / instance profile (recommended on AWS).
fields.label: Access Key ID

fields.description: Leave blank when using an IAM role. Required only if an Access Key ID is set.
fields.label: Secret Access Key

fields.description: Optional. Set for S3-compatible services (MinIO, DigitalOcean Spaces, Wasabi). Leave blank for AWS S3.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: S3 storage tier for uploaded objects.
fields.label: Storage Class
fields.options:
STANDARD
STANDARD_IA
INTELLIGENT_TIERING
ONEZONE_IA
GLACIER_IR
DEEP_ARCHIVE

fields.description: Lifetime of generated download links, in seconds (clamped to 60–604800).
fields.label: Presigned URL Expiry (seconds)

fields.description: Send a Content-MD5 header so S3 rejects a corrupted upload instead of storing it.
fields.label: Verify Upload Integrity

fields.description: When enabled, the daily scheduler uploads site backups to S3 (under backups/<site>/).
fields.label: Enable Daily Backup Sync

fields.description: Storage tier for backups (independent of attachments — e.g. STANDARD_IA or GLACIER_IR for cheaper cold storage).
fields.label: Backup Storage Class
fields.options:
STANDARD
STANDARD_IA
INTELLIGENT_TIERING
ONEZONE_IA
GLACIER_IR
DEEP_ARCHIVE

fields.description: Delete the local backup file after it is verified present in S3 (reclaims server disk space).
fields.label: Delete Local Backup After Sync

fields.description: Off by default: every upload on the site goes to S3. When on, only attachments of the doctypes listed below are stored in S3 — everything else keeps using Frappe's local storage, and the migration jobs leave it alone. Files already in the bucket keep being served and deleted normally either way.
fields.label: Limit S3 Storage to Specific Doctypes

fields.description: One doctype per line, e.g. Sales Invoice. Matched against the attachment's Attached To Doctype.
fields.label: Doctypes Stored in S3

fields.description: Also store files that are not attached to any document (uploads from the File list, letter head / print logos, Web Form uploads before submission). Off means those stay on local disk.
fields.label: Include Files Not Attached to a Document

fields.description: Serve a private object to an anonymous visitor when the File record is owned by Guest (e.g. a Web Form attachment they just uploaded). The object stays private in the bucket and is served through a short-lived presigned URL.
fields.label: Allow Guests to Download Their Own Uploads

fields.description: Optional. One doctype per line: restricts the rule above to guest uploads attached to these doctypes. Leave empty to allow any guest upload.
fields.label: Guest Readable Doctypes

fields.description: Migrate a capped number of pre-existing local files to S3 automatically every day, until none remain. Progress is visible in the 'Migration Status' button.
fields.label: Enable Daily Auto-Migration

fields.description: Maximum files to migrate per day.
fields.label: Files Per Day

fields.description: Delete each local copy right after it is migrated and verified in S3, so disk frees up as files move. Enable only after verifying a sample migrated correctly (attachments, images, print formats).
fields.label: Delete Local After Migration
